problem_restatement.question: Did the live canary provide an adequate promotion basis for the $5,000 v51 portfolio, and what is the safest growth-oriented response to the realized loss pattern?
problem_restatement.population: All six exact v51-compatible closed lifecycles plus the two exact open protected lifecycles through the captured checkpoint prefix.
problem_restatement.baseline: The v39 approximately $500 canary configuration and the prior v51 continue-unchanged decision.
problem_restatement.success_criterion: Attribute the loss to exposure, strategy, execution, or telemetry without pooling incompatible identities, then request one reversible live action.

exposure_translation.interpretation: The promotion simultaneously increased bankroll, margin fraction, and leverage. Canary dollar outcomes did not directly validate the resulting stop-loss magnitude.

canary_promotion_failure.evidence: v51 was granted materially larger exposure before source-compatible route economics were established; all three represented strategy clusters are now net negative.
canary_promotion_failure.falsifier: A pre-deployment artifact showing positive exact-v51 forward evidence across the represented routes, costs, sides, and exposure contract would invalidate this finding; none was identified.

removed_assets.evidence: SNDK had two prior long losses totaling -$1.343329. BRENTOIL breakout was 1W/1L, -$0.232469 and negative without its largest winner. Removing them reduced breadth but avoided reusing weak mechanisms.
removed_assets.falsifier: A source-compatible positive canary distribution for either removed route that was available before v51 would update this assessment.

execution_degradation.evidence: Costs reduced results by $15.408243, but gross market PnL was already -$30.434395. No route identity, stop protection, or duplicate-position defect is present in the captured prefix.
execution_degradation.falsifier: A reconciled fill audit showing missing fees, abnormal slippage, missed exits, or incorrect route identity would elevate execution failure.

strategy_and_exit_fit.evidence: HYPE surrendered a +32.71 bps favorable excursion before a stop-sized loss; ETH Range barely cleared its 10.59 bps cost hurdle and reversed; the index cluster is negative and largest-winner dependent.
strategy_and_exit_fit.falsifier: Additional independent exact-v51 episodes that produce positive after-cost results on both configured sides and remain positive without their largest winner would weaken this diagnosis.

normal_variance.evidence: Six closes are statistically sparse, but uncertainty cuts both ways: it cannot justify a profitability claim or continued full-size entry authority.
normal_variance.falsifier: A predeclared larger forward window with stable positive route-level outcomes would show the current sequence was ordinary adverse variance.

decision_update.superseded_decision: Continue exact v51 execution unchanged after five closes.
decision_update.new_decision: Do not treat unchanged v51 as a justified promoted portfolio. Request a global transition drain to stop new entries while existing protected positions retain their bound exits and venue stops.
decision_update.reason: The sixth compatible close and exact exposure translation convert the earlier warning into an approval-ready containment decision.

change_proposal.Recommendation: Activate the global v51 transition drain now. Preserve the two existing venue stops and bound exit plans; create no new positions. After flat, archive the exact run and review a successor profile separately.
change_proposal.Why now: Every represented v51 strategy cluster is negative, the exposure increase was not supported by compatible forward evidence, and new entry authority remains enabled.
change_proposal.Evidence reviewed: Exact live checkpoint and ledger prefix, six compatible lifecycle reflections, two protected open lifecycles, v39 and v51 sizing contracts, prior v51 continue decision, exit diagnostics, and removed-asset evidence.
change_proposal.Observed problem or opportunity: The system multiplied per-position notional approximately 66.7x from canary to v51 while replacing or altering route identities that lacked comparable forward evidence.
change_proposal.Applicable market regime: All regimes. The proposal is a promotion-contract containment action, not a market-direction prediction.
Alternatives considered: drain new entries while preserving bound exits
change_proposal.Proposed live change: Submit one transition_drain operator command for the exact active run/profile. Do not alter stops, leverage, position size, or exit controllers in place.
change_proposal.Expected upside: Caps further strategy-entry exposure while retaining fail-closed protection and an auditable flat transition.
change_proposal.Main risks and failure modes: Open SOL/SPCX can still lose to their stops; a drain command can be rejected on run/profile mismatch; opportunity cost occurs if a valid signal appears during the drain.
change_proposal.Validation completed: Runtime/profile identity match, backend health, transition drain inactive, open-position protection, compatible accounting, exposure translation, and route-level contribution reconciliation.
change_proposal.Validation still required: Fresh command-time run/profile identity, command outcome acceptance, checkpoint transition_drain=active, every future entry withheld, and final flat/order-free completion.
change_proposal.Success metrics: No new entries after activation; existing exits remain managed; both venue and ledgers become flat/order-free; completed drain archives with exact identity.
change_proposal.Failure / rollback triggers: Reject/stop on identity mismatch, stale backend, missing protection, duplicate command, or any new entry after acknowledged activation. No rollback to entry authority until a separately approved successor preflight passes.
change_proposal.Explicit approval requested: Approve activation of the exact v51 transition drain.

single_highest_value_next_investigation: After drain approval and while existing positions resolve, construct the successor route matrix from mechanisms with exact source-compatible evidence; do not reuse Range Onset or retired Brent/SNDK routes unchanged.
limitations: Six closes are insufficient to estimate durable strategy expectancy precisely.
The checkpoint source is rolling; the recorded SHA-256 binds the captured prefix only.
Open SOL and SPCX outcomes remain unresolved and can change total PnL.
A transition drain prevents new entries but does not eliminate loss risk on already-open positions.
No live strategy, route, parameter, leverage, sizing, risk, execution, or deployment setting changed in this report-only revision.
